metadata.notice: Example migration paths for the animation. One route per species for 2006, 2010, 2015, and 2020. Coordinates, months, and depths are invented along published corridors. They are not satellite tracks or predictions from a fitted model.
metadata.time_basis: Each route is one calendar year. Month positions are the 15th.
metadata.depth_notice: depth_m values are sample drawing depths inside the species' stated range, shallower in nesting months. They are not measured dives.
